title: [Windows] Ashampoo Burning Studio 2027, Lifetime License $0 (Normally $30) @ Ashampoo
body:
Deal: [Windows] Ashampoo Burning Studio 2027, Lifetime License $0 (Normally $30) @ Ashampoo

[MasterScythe] Ive always liked Ashampoo. I find they do what they say on the box, usually don't bloat extra features, and being german handle my details with GDPR - and while I prefer FOSS, gdpr gives me at least some peace of mind.
Suits me for BDXL backups of family albums.
Keep it up fellas.
[GreenLego] When you start the installation, there is a button that says 'get activation key' and click on that and it will open up a web page to subscribe to the newsletter.
[YoursTruly] Op, thank for the deal.
Ashampoo - what’s the story behind the name?
[eggboi] The idea came to him when he farted.
It was a sham poo
[YoursTruly] I haven’t heard anyone ending a sneeze with a ‘poo’ sound lol
[YoursTruly] @WatchNerd: I am out.
Which room in your parents house are you all day in?
[YoursTruly] Op, I recall the PC cleaner was “cleans your PC like a shampoo”
Burner though?
[Jackson] He was trying to capitalise on the Sham Wow! name
[Click_It] 2006 Optical backups to NAS
2026 NAS backups to Optical
[frostee] I was hoping for a deal on your other product for repairing damaged discs, Aconditioner.
[Jackson] You need to use A shampoo first anyway so you are part way there.
If things arent holding up long term consider using a hair spray also
[Scramble] Thanks! Just downloaded it. FYI I didn't have to sign up for any newsletter to get the license key
[cobknob] Why not just issue unique serial numbers attached to names and email addresses. I'm not a big fan of…
Do this
Do that
Visit a page
Create an account
Subscribe to a newsletter
Get your code
Install the app and activate with said code
Why not.. just go
Register your name and email, and select checkbox for newsletter subscribe
You will then automagically receive unique serial number to email address provided to use with our application anytime - provide a link to said application
And as an alternative you can provide an in-app install promo or/and through email to a premium version of the software to upgrade to for a fee$.
That would be way easier 🥱🥳
